routes.name: Digital nomad (Stay for Remote Workers and Service Providers, Ley 10008)
routes.summary: Lets you work remotely for clients outside Costa Rica. It extends a 90-day tourist stay to one year, renewable for one more year.

income.note: USD 4,000 per month if bringing dependents. Income must come from outside Costa Rica.

other: Must provide paid remote services to clients outside Costa Rica
Medical insurance for the whole stay, minimum USD 50,000 coverage, dependents included
Bank statements for the past year with a sworn affidavit, or a certification from a public accountant or notary (apostilled or consularly legalized)
Criminal and police record checks by DGME

sources.label: Visit Costa Rica (ICT): digital nomad requirements

documents: Passport photo page and entry stamp page

fees.label: Government payment
fees.note: Bank fees, including a USD 15 Banco de Costa Rica fee, can reduce the amount received

steps: Apply online at tramiteya.go.cr/dgme or at a DGME office
